title: HumanoidNDM: Closing the Training-Deployment Gap of Motion Tracking via Humanoid Neural Dynamics Model
abstract: arXiv:2610.34126v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Humanoid robots have recently achieved remarkable success in motion tracking. However, during real-world deployment, robots inevitably encounter dynamics gaps arising from either extra physical disturbances or inaccurate simulation modeling, resulting in a significant training-deployment gap. Therefore, effectively leveraging real-world data to fine-tune policies represents the crucial last mile for robust deployment. To bridge this gap, we propose HumanoidNDM, an online fine-tuning framework for humanoid motion tracking driven by a real-world-trained neural dynamics model. translated_title: HumanoidNDM：通过人形神经动力学模型弥合运动追踪的训练-部署差距
translated_abstract: 人形机器人近来在运动追踪方面取得了显著成功。然而，在真实世界部署过程中，机器人不可避免地会遇到由额外物理干扰或仿真建模不准确导致的动力学差距，从而产生显著的训练-部署差距。因此，有效利用真实世界数据对策略进行微调，是实现稳健部署的关键最后一环。为弥合这一差距，我们提出了HumanoidNDM，一个由真实世界训练的神经动力学模型驱动的人形运动追踪在线微调框架。首先，在数据采集阶段，我们引入了一种带自适应强度机制的低频参考扰动方法，在部署可行性与探索效率之间取得平衡。其次，在模型训练阶段，我们通过结合可微分前向运动学，在欧几里得空间中训练出一个鲁棒的、基于历史信息与本体感觉的神经动力学模型。
tldr: 提出HumanoidNDM框架，利用真实世界数据训练的神经动力学模型对人形机器人运动追踪策略进行在线微调，从而弥合仿真训练与真实部署之间的动力学差距。
en_tdlr: HumanoidNDM closes the training-deployment gap in humanoid motion tracking by online fine-tuning policies with a real-world-trained neural dynamics model, using adaptive low-frequency reference perturbation for efficient real-world data collection.
